\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  \def\ops{{"$\hat a_{\mathbf k'}$","$\hat a_{\mathbf p'}$","$\hat{\bar\psi}_x$","$\hat\psi_x$","$\hat{\bar\psi}_y$","$\hat\psi_y$","$\hat a^\dagger_{\mathbf p}$","$\hat a^\dagger_{\mathbf k}$"}}
  \tikzset{arc/.style={line width=0.8pt, figB}, cr/.style={circle, fill=figO, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=4pt}}
  % ---- t pattern ----
  \begin{scope}
    \foreach \i in {1,...,8} { \node (t\i) at (1.15*\i,0) {\pgfmathparse{\ops[\i-1]}\pgfmathresult}; }
    \node[anchor=east] at (0.45,0) {$\langle0|$}; \node[anchor=west] at (9.75,0) {$|0\rangle$};
    % arcs (2,3),(4,7),(1,5),(6,8): height ~ span
    \draw[arc] (t2.north) to[out=70,in=110] (t3.north);
    \draw[arc] (t4.north) to[out=70,in=110,looseness=0.9] (t7.north);
    \draw[arc] (t1.north) to[out=75,in=105,looseness=0.95] (t5.north);
    \draw[arc] (t6.north) to[out=70,in=110] (t8.north);
    \node[fdS,align=left,anchor=west] at (10.6,0.55) {$t$: $\hat{\bar\psi}_x{\leftrightarrow}p'$, $\hat\psi_x{\leftrightarrow}p$,\\ $\hat{\bar\psi}_y{\leftrightarrow}k'$, $\hat\psi_y{\leftrightarrow}k$\\ 2 crossings: sign $+$};

  % ---- u pattern ----
  \begin{scope}[yshift=-2.6cm]
    \foreach \i in {1,...,8} { \node (u\i) at (1.15*\i,0) {\pgfmathparse{\ops[\i-1]}\pgfmathresult}; }

    % arcs (1,3),(2,5),(4,7),(6,8)
    \draw[arc] (u1.north) to[out=70,in=110] (u3.north);
    \draw[arc] (u2.north) to[out=72,in=108,looseness=0.95] (u5.north);
    \draw[arc] (u4.north) to[out=70,in=110,looseness=0.9] (u7.north);
    \draw[arc] (u6.north) to[out=70,in=110] (u8.north);
    \node[fdS,align=left,anchor=west] at (10.6,0.55) {$u$: $\hat{\bar\psi}_x{\leftrightarrow}k'$, $\hat\psi_x{\leftrightarrow}p$,\\ $\hat{\bar\psi}_y{\leftrightarrow}p'$, $\hat\psi_y{\leftrightarrow}k$\\ 3 crossings: sign $-$};
